description: This file defines a Swing UI component for configuring the 'HonoReceiverSampler' in a JMeter testing environment. It provides GUI elements for setting parameters related to the Hono receiver, including server options, endpoint, tenant, container, timing options, prefetch, and reconnect attempts. The class allows creating, modifying, and clearing the UI state corresponding to the sampler configuration.

classes.name: HonoReceiverSamplerUI
classes.description: Swing UI class for configuring the HonoReceiverSampler with various input fields, options, and logic for synchronizing UI state with the underlying test element.

methods.name: HonoReceiverSamplerUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GUI components and layouts for the sampler configuration.

methods.name: getStaticLabel
methods.description: Returns the static label for this UI component.

methods.name: createTestElement
methods.description: Creates a new instance of HonoReceiverSampler and applies the current UI state to it.

methods.name: modifyTestElement
methods.description: Modifies the provided TestElement (assumed to be HonoReceiverSampler) with current UI field values.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the UI fields based on the state of the given HonoReceiverSampler instance.

methods.name: clearGui
methods.description: Resets all UI components to default/empty state.

methods.name: createTimeStampPanel
methods.description: Creates a panel with radio buttons and checkbox for timestamp-related configuration.
